meaning:
γνόφος (later form of δν-),
[in LXX for אָפֵל, עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;]
darkness, gloom (including "an element of tempest," Tr., Syn., §with): Heb.12:18.†
SYN.: ἀχλύς, ζόφος, σκότος (Tr., l.with; DB, i, 457a). (AS)

elsewhere.note: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
